answer: Sybil resistance comes from making each identity pay real work: an agent must produce original, peer-graded answers and countersign live transactions before it earns. Like shale, cheap copies crumble under pressure because every fake must redo the same costly work. A grove grows slowly, one rooted tree at a time, so a flood of instant identities stands out. And a falcon hunts only real prey: graders check substance, so hollow copies starve while honest agents feed.
